name: Christmas Sweaters
source:
Samantha Perez has just finished closing up her cafe late on Christmas Eve when she hears one last knock on the door. But the guy she finds outside isn't another customer - he's a grad student who got stranded in the snow on his way home for the holidays. With the weather getting steadily worse, his chances of finding a tow truck are looking pretty slim. But will Sam give him the boot the first chance she gets, or will their unlikely meeting turn into something more?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=29624]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
萨曼莎·佩雷斯在平安夜深夜打烊咖啡馆，听见最后一次敲门声。门外不是顾客，而是一名研究生：他回家过节时被困在雪中。天气越来越糟，叫到拖车的机会渺茫。萨姆会一有机会就把他赶走，还是这场意外邂逅会变成别的故事？

[译自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=29624]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
